html:
If you stay in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon) and would like to have a day trip to the Mekong Delta but do not know which is the best way. You should book a private car Ho Chi Minh to Mekong Delta transfer via Vietlook Travel.

By booking our Saigon to Mekong Delta by private car, you will have door-to-door service in a comfortable vehicle with an experienced driver. The distance from Saigon to the Mekong Delta depends on what route you take.

For a great experience in the Mekong Delta, Vietlook Travel highly recommends 2 popular routes including Saigon to My Tho (the Mekong Delta) 67km which takes an hour and 30 minutes transfer, or Ho Chi Minh to Ben Tre (Mekong Delta) 84km which takes an hour and 50 minutes.

HO CHI MINH TO MEKONG DELTA BY PRIVATE CAR

Please provide us with your hotel name/ address in Saigon for pickup, the number of people, and the travel date. Vietlook Travel owns many types of vehicles from Sedans to SUVs, and Minivans to meet all your group sizes and ensure you a comfortable day from Saigon to Mekong Delta.

The private transfer from Ho Chi Minh to Mekong Delta by car will take about 1.5 hours when we take the My Tho destination. Along the way from Saigon to My Tho, our friendly driver will be happy to stop at a convenient place for you to take a short break, drink some coffee, or use the toilet.

Upon arrival at My Tho, our experienced driver will drop you off at the My Tho Marina, Tien Giang province where he will help you to take a boat to explore the Mekong Delta.

Our professional driver will wait for you at My Tho Marina, Tien Giang province, and give you enough time to enjoy the Mekong Delta Tour and then transfer you back to the Ho Chi Minh City Hotel. We finish the Saigon to Mekong Delta private car transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great day with us.

Travel Thoughts

  • An English-speaking tour guide is highly recommended.
  • Full charge your camera and phones for beautiful photos.
  • You should choose the departure time at 8 AM and will be back at the hotel around 7 PM.
  • When visiting rural villages, temples, or family-run workshops, be respectful of local customs.
  • Bring some cash with you because the local vendors in the floating markets or villages may only accept cash.
  • consider starting your tour early in the morning, especially if you want to see the vibrant floating markets at their liveliest.
  • The Mekong Delta can be hot and humid, so wear comfortable clothes, and don’t forget sunscreen, a hat, and insect repellent.

  • We own a wide range of cars which will meet all your group sizes.
  • We always offer our customers the best price without any hidden fees.

  • Our travel experts are willing to customize the itinerary following your request.
  • A door-to-door private car 2 ways from Ho Chi Minh to the Mekong Delta in a day.
  • Our private cars are all in good condition comfortable and spacious, ensuring you travel in comfort.
